subject: Mathematics
source: IISER IAT 2025, final answer key (English), iiseradmission.in
_transcription: Pages p33-p47 of the 2025 render, one question per page (p33 = Q1 under the 'Mathematics' heading ... p47 = Q15). Each page prints 'N. Question N' and the subject's own page footer 1-15; numbers run 1-15 unbroken with no continuation or blank pages. The 'Question N' header line is dropped from the stems. No figures. Options kept in printed order.

rows.text: How many three digit numbers divisible by 5 are there in which **no** digits are repeated?

Let \(A\) be a \(3 \times 3\) matrix with real entries such that

\(A = \begin{bmatrix} 4 & -1 & \cos x \\ -1 & 5x & 25 \\ x^2 + 1 & 25 & 7 \end{bmatrix}.\)

For how many values of \(x\), the matrix \(A\) is symmetric?

rows.subtopic: Binomial Theorem for Positive Integral Indices
rows.text: Let \(n = \sum_{r=0}^{10} (-1)^r \, {}^{10}C_r \left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^{2r} 3^{20}\). Which one of the following statements is TRUE?
Let \(f : \mathbf{R} \to \mathbf{R}\) be the function given by \(f(x) = \cos(\tan^{-1} x)\). Which one of the following statements is TRUE?

rows.subtopic: Algebraic Solutions of Linear Inequalities in One Variable
rows.text:
Let

\(A = \left\{ x \in \mathbf{R} \;\middle|\; -31 < \det \begin{bmatrix} 3x - 1 & 2 \\ -2 & 5 \end{bmatrix} \le 29 \right\}.\)

Which one of the following statements is TRUE?

Let \(z_1, z_2\), and \(z_3\) be complex numbers satisfying the following conditions

\(2 = |2z_1| = |z_2 - 1| = |z_3 + 1| = \left| \frac{1}{z_1} + \frac{1}{z_2 - 1} + \frac{1}{z_3 + 1} \right|.\)

What is the value of \(|4z_1 + z_2 + z_3|\)?
Let \(f : \mathbf{R} \to \mathbf{R}\) be defined as \(f(x) = |x^3 - 3x|[x]\), where \([x]\) denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to \(x\). Which one of the following statements is TRUE?
options: Every non-zero integer is a point of discontinuity of \(f\)
\(f\) is continuous at every real number
Every integer is a point of discontinuity of \(f\)
\(f\) is continuous at every real number except for \(0, \pm\sqrt{3}\)

rows.text: Let \(\ell\) be the tangent line to the ellipse \(x^2 + 16y^2 = 4\) at \(\left(1, \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}\right)\). What is the equation of the line perpendicular to \(\ell\) passing through \((2, 0)\)?

Let \(\vec{a}\) and \(\vec{b}\) be two vectors such that \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b}| = 15\) and

\(\vec{a} \times (3\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}) = (3\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}) \times \vec{b}.\)

What is the value of \(|(\vec{a} + \vec{b}) \cdot (2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + \hat{k})|\)?
What is the derivative of \(\log(\sin^2 x)\) with respect to \(\sin x\)?
Let \(S_n\) denote the sum of the first \(n\) terms of a sequence \(a_1, a_2, a_3, \ldots\). If \(S_{n+3} - S_n = 13n + 7\) for all \(n\), what is the value of \(a_{13} - a_{10}\)?
Five fair coins are tossed independently. What is the probability that at least two heads appear?

Let \(f : \mathbf{R} \to \mathbf{R}\) be the function defined by

\(f(x) = \begin{cases} x^2 - 4x - 5 & \text{if } x \ge 1, \\ 2x & \text{if } x < 1. \end{cases}\)

Which one of the following statements is TRUE?

Which one of the following is the solution of the differential equation

\(x^2 \frac{dy}{dx} + 9xy = x^4\) (for \(x > 0\)),

given that \(y = 0\) when \(x = 1\)?
What is the value of \(\int_0^{\pi} x |\cos x| \sin x \, dx\)?
